records.literal_gloss: And they answered with praising and with giving thanks to YHWH: for [he is] good, for to forever [is] his steadfast love over Israel. And all the people shouted a shout great with praising to YHWH because was founded [the] house of YHWH.

en.L: And they sang responsively, praising and giving thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: "For [{{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is] good, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} steadfast love toward Israel [is] forever." And all the people shouted with a great shout, praising {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was founded.
en.B: They sang in response to one another, praising and giving thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: "He is good; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful love for Israel lasts forever." And all the people gave a great shout of praise to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because the foundation of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had been laid.
en.R: They sang back and forth, praising and thanking {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: "He is good! His faithful love for Israel lasts forever." All the people shouted loudly and praised {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because the foundation of the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had been laid.

es.L: Y cantaban alternándose, alabando y dando gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «Porque [{{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es] bueno, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal para con Israel [es] para siempre». Y todo el pueblo gritó con gran júbilo, alabando {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque se habían echado los cimientos de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Cantaban respondiéndose unos a otros, alabando y dando gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «Él es bueno; {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel por Israel dura para siempre». Y todo el pueblo lanzó un gran grito de alabanza {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque se habían echado los cimientos de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Cantaban por turnos, alabando y dando gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «¡Él es bueno! Su amor fiel por Israel dura para siempre». Todo el pueblo gritaba con fuerza y alababa {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque ya se habían puesto los cimientos del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et ils chantèrent en se répondant, louant et rendant grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Car [{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est] bon, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal envers Israël [est] pour toujours. » Et tout le peuple poussa une grande clameur en louant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce que la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} était fondée.
fr.B: Ils chantaient en se répondant les uns aux autres, louant et remerciant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : « Il est bon ; {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle pour Israël dure toujours. » Et tout le peuple poussa une grande clameur de louange {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, parce que les fondations de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} avaient été posées.
fr.R: Ils chantaient en alternance, en louant et en remerciant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : « Il est bon ! Son amour fidèle pour Israël dure toujours. » Tout le peuple a poussé de grands cris et a loué {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce que les fondations du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} avaient été posées.

sw.L: Wakaimba kwa kupokezana, wakimsifu na kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: "Kwa maana [{{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni] mwema, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma kwa Israeli [ni] wa milele." Na watu wote wakapiga kelele kwa sauti kuu, wakimsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ilikuwa imewekewa msingi.
sw.B: Waliimba kwa kupokezana, wakimsifu na kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: "Yeye ni mwema; upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma kwa Israeli unadumu milele." Watu wote wakapiga kelele kuu ya kumsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu msingi wa nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ulikuwa umewekwa.
sw.R: Waliimba kwa zamu, wakimsifu na kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: "Yeye ni mwema! Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma kwa Israeli unadumu milele." Watu wote wakapiga kelele kwa nguvu na kumsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu msingi wa hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ulikuwa umewekwa.

vi.L: Và họ hát đối đáp nhau, ca ngợi và cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Vì [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là] tốt lành, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đối với Y-sơ-ra-ên [là] đời đời." Và cả dân chúng reo hò một tiếng reo lớn, ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã được đặt nền.
vi.B: Họ hát đối đáp nhau, ca ngợi và cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Ngài là tốt lành; tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đối với Y-sơ-ra-ên còn đến đời đời." Cả dân chúng đều reo hò lớn tiếng ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì nền nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã được đặt.
vi.R: Họ hát qua hát lại, ca ngợi và cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Ngài tốt lành! Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dành cho Y-sơ-ra-ên còn đến đời đời." Cả dân chúng reo hò thật lớn và ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì nền đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã được đặt.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 찬양하고 감사하며 화답하여 노래했다. "[그분은] 선하시기 때문이다. 참으로 이스라엘을 향한 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다." 그리고 온 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하며 큰 함성을 질렀다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 기초가 놓였기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그들은 서로 화답하며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 찬양하고 감사했다. "그분은 선하시다. 이스라엘을 향한 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다." {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 기초가 놓였으므로, 온 백성이 큰 함성을 지르며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양했다.
ko.R: 그들은 서로 주고받으며 노래로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하고 감사했다. "그분은 좋으신 분이시다! 이스라엘을 향한 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다." {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 기초가 놓였으므로, 온 백성이 크게 소리치며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양했다.

pt.L: E cantaram em resposta, louvando e rendendo graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}: "Porque [{{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é] bom, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal por Israel [é] para sempre." E todo o povo deu um grande grito, louvando {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, porque a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} estava fundada.
pt.B: Eles cantavam respondendo uns aos outros, louvando e rendendo graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}: "Porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é bom; o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal por Israel dura para sempre." E todo o povo deu um grande grito de louvor {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, porque os alicerces da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} tinham sido lançados.
pt.R: Eles cantavam, um grupo respondendo ao outro, louvando e agradecendo {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}: "Porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é bom! O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal por Israel dura para sempre." Todo o povo gritou bem alto e louvou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, porque os alicerces do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} tinham sido lançados.

am.L: {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} እያወደሱና ምስጋና እያቀረቡ እየተቀባበሉ ዘመሩ፦ «መልካም ነውና፤ ለእስራኤልም ያለው ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና።» ሕዝቡም ሁሉ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤት ስለ ተመሠረተ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እያወደሱ በታላቅ እልልታ እልል አሉ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እያወደሱና እያመሰገኑ እርስ በርሳቸው እየተቀባበሉ እንዲህ ብለው ዘመሩ፦ «እርሱ መልካም ነው፤ ለእስራኤል ያለው ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ይኖራል።» {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ መሠረት ስለ ተጣለም ሕዝቡ ሁሉ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እያወደሱ በታላቅ ድምፅ እልል አሉ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እያወደሱና እያመሰገኑ እየተቀባበሉ እንዲህ ብለው ዘመሩ፦ «እርሱ መልካም ነው! ለእስራኤል ያለው ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ይኖራል።» {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ መሠረት ስለ ተጣለ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ በታላቅ ድምፅ እልል እያሉ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አወደሱ።

hi.L: और उन्होंने बारी-बारी से गाकर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति और धन्यवाद किया: "क्योंकि [वे] भले [हैं], क्योंकि इस्राएल पर उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]।" और सब लोगों ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति करते हुए बड़ा जयजयकार किया, क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन की नींव डाली गई थी।
hi.B: उन्होंने एक-दूसरे को उत्तर देते हुए गाकर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति और धन्यवाद किया: "क्योंकि वे भले हैं; इस्राएल पर उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।" और सब लोगों ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति में बड़ा जयजयकार किया, क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भवन की नींव डाली गई थी।
hi.R: उन्होंने बारी-बारी से गाते हुए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति की और उनका धन्यवाद किया: "क्योंकि वे भले हैं! इस्राएल पर उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।" सब लोगों ने ऊँचे स्वर से जयजयकार करके {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति की, क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मन्दिर की नींव डाली गई थी।

ru.L: И пели попеременно, хваля и благодаря {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}: «Потому что [{{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}] благ, потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} к Израилю.» И весь народ восклицал великим восклицанием, хваля {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, потому что был основан дом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Они пели, отвечая друг другу, хваля и благодаря {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}: «Он добр; {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь к Израилю длится вечно.» И весь народ громко восклицал, хваля {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, потому что было заложено основание дома {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Они пели по очереди, хваля и благодаря {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}: «Он добр! Его неизменная любовь к Израилю длится вечно.» Весь народ громко кричал и хвалил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, потому что было заложено основание храма {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.

ja.L: そして彼らは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を賛美し、感謝しながら応答して歌った。「その方は良い方であり、イスラエルに対するその誠実はとこしえに[続く]。」そして民は皆、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を賛美して大きな叫び声を上げた。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家の基が据えられたからである。
ja.B: 彼らは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を賛美し、感謝して、互いに応え合って歌った。「その方は良い方、イスラエルに対するその変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。」そして民は皆、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を賛美して大きな歓声を上げた。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の家の基礎が据えられたからである。
ja.R: 彼らは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を賛美し、感謝して、かわるがわる歌いました。「その方は良い方だから！イスラエルへのその変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。」民は皆、大きな声で叫んで{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を賛美しました。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の神殿の土台が据えられたからです。

uk.L: І співали навперемін, хвалячи і дякуючи {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}: «Бо [{{deity_pronoun:він|Він}}] добрий, бо навіки {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов до Ізраїля.» І весь народ закричав великим криком, хвалячи {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, бо закладено дім {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Вони співали, відповідаючи одні одним, хвалили і дякували {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}: «Він добрий; {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов до Ізраїля навіки.» І весь народ вигукнув великим вигуком хвали {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, бо закладено основу дому {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Вони співали по черзі, хвалили і дякували {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}: «Він добрий! Його вірна любов до Ізраїля навіки.» Увесь народ голосно кричав і хвалив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, бо основу храму {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} було закладено.

decisions.choice: answered: sang in response, one group answering another
decisions.reason: "Answer" is used of singing back and forth, one group calling and the other responding (Exodus 15:21; 1 Samuel 18:7). The priests and Levites of verse 10 sang the praise in turns.

decisions.choice: for he is good, for his steadfast love is forever: the temple refrain
decisions.reason: These are the words of the well-known song of thanks (Psalm 106:1; 107:1; 118:1; 136:1). They were sung when the ark was brought into Solomon's temple and when it was dedicated (2 Chronicles 5:13; 7:3). Here they are sung again at the start of the second temple, with "toward Israel" added.

decisions.choice: steadfast love: the LORD's loyal, covenant kindness
decisions.reason: The word means love that keeps faith with a bond or covenant: kindness that does not give up. Ezra uses it of God's favor shown through the Persian kings (7:28; 9:9).

decisions.choice: a great shout: a loud cry of joy and acclaim
decisions.reason: The word is the shout raised at a festival, a victory or a king's coming (1 Samuel 4:5; Psalm 47:6), here in praise as the work began.

decisions.choice: steadfast love (Literal); faithful love (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Numbers to Ruth term list, which applies to Ezra, gives these words for this term.

decisions.choice: He is good; ... lasts forever
decisions.reason: The two "for" words introduce what is sung; Balanced and Readable leave them out and quote the words directly, while Literal keeps them.

decisions.choice: "porque [él es] bueno, porque su amor leal ... [es] para siempre" (L); "Él es bueno; su amor fiel ... dura para siempre" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The temple refrain in the published wording of Psalm 136:1, with "para con Israel" / "por Israel" added as the Hebrew adds it; "amor leal" (L) and "amor fiel" (B, R) for *ḥesed*, as the terms note sets them.

decisions.choice: the refrain in the wording of the Swahili Psalm 136:1 at each level, with "kwa Israeli" added; "upendo usiokoma" at every level
decisions.reason: Ezra 3:11 sings the temple refrain; keeping the published Psalm wording lets a reader hear it, and only what the Hebrew adds is added.

decisions.choice: the refrain of Psalm 136 and 2 Chronicles 5:13
decisions.reason: Each level keeps the French refrain published in Psalm 136 and 2 Chronicles 5:13: "car [il est] bon, car son amour loyal [est] pour toujours" (Literal), "il est bon ... son amour fidèle dure toujours" (Balanced, Readable), adding only Ezra's "envers Israël" / "pour Israël". Literal says "amour loyal" for *ḥesed*, as the Psalms do, where the English Literal here says "steadfast love".

decisions.choice: the Psalm 136:1 refrain
decisions.reason: The song is the temple refrain (m2), so each level keeps its wording from Psalm 136:1: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (Literal, Balanced) and "tình thương không hề thay đổi" (Readable) for the loyal love, "[là] đời đời" (Literal) and "còn đến đời đời" (Balanced, Readable). Only "đối với / dành cho Y-sơ-ra-ên", which Ezra adds, is new.

decisions.choice: The refrain reuses the Korean of Psalm 136:1 at each level, adding "이스라엘을 향한"
alternatives: A new wording of the refrain
decisions.reason: The terms note: the temple refrain keeps the published wording of Psalm 136 (also 2 Chronicles 5:13), so readers hear the same song; Ezra adds "toward Israel".

decisions.choice: Porque [ele é] bom, porque o seu amor leal por Israel [é] para sempre (L); Porque ele é bom; o seu amor leal por Israel dura para sempre (B); Porque ele é bom! O seu amor leal por Israel dura para sempre (R)
alternatives: alt: Ele é bom (B, R, as the English)
decisions.reason: For Ezra-Nehemiah: the temple refrain (m2) keeps the wording 1 Chronicles 16:34 and 2 Chronicles 5:13 have in Portuguese at each level, with "por Israel" added where Ezra's Hebrew has it. Balanced and Readable keep "Porque", which the English leaves out, so that the refrain reads the same as in Chronicles; "amor leal" at every level for God's hesed (m3), "render graças" (L, B) and "agradecer" (R) as there.

decisions.choice: The temple refrain: "መልካም ነውና፤ ለእስራኤልም ያለው ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና" (Literal), "እርሱ መልካም ነው፤ ለእስራኤል ያለው ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ይኖራል" (Balanced, Readable); *ḥesed* is "ጽኑ ፍቅር" at every level
decisions.reason: "ጽኑ ፍቅር" is the terms list's word for *ḥesed*; where the English Balanced and Readable say "faithful love" the Amharic word already says it. The refrain recurs in Chronicles and the Psalms, which can keep this shape where the Hebrew is the same; the familiar wording of the 1962 Bible is avoided.

decisions.choice: "እየተቀባበሉ ዘመሩ" for "they answered": they sang in turn, one group taking up the other
decisions.reason: "መለሱ" (answered) would suggest a reply to a question; the meaning decision says the groups sang responsively.

decisions.choice: the refrain of 1 Chronicles 16:34, with "इस्राएल पर"
decisions.reason: Each level reuses its wording of the refrain from 1 Chronicles 16:34 ("क्योंकि [वे] भले [हैं] ... उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]"; "क्योंकि वे भले हैं" and "सदा बना रहता है" at Balanced and Readable), since the Hebrew is the same, "for" included; it adds only "इस्राएल पर" where Ezra has "toward Israel". Steadfast love is अटल प्रेम at every level, as the Pentateuch note sets.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
alternatives: deity_pronoun spans as in the English
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun spans have no Hindi counterpart; the honorific plural (वे, उनका) marks God at every level.

decisions.choice: the refrain of 1 Chronicles 16:34: "потому что [он] благ, потому что вовек неизменная любовь его" (L); "он добр; его неизменная любовь длится вечно" (B, R), with "к Израилю" added
decisions.reason: The temple refrain keeps its wording from 1 Chronicles 16:34 in this translation; Ezra adds "toward Israel". As in the English, Balanced and Readable drop the two "for" words and quote the song directly. Hesed is "неизменная любовь", as the Pentateuch note sets for the LORD's steadfast love.

decisions.choice: The refrain worded as 1CH 16:34, 41 (L "その方は良い方であり、…その誠実はとこしえに[続く]", without からである inside the quotation as 2CH 5:13, B "その方は良い方、…その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く", R "その方は良い方だから！…いつまでも続く"), with "イスラエルに対する" (L, B), "イスラエルへの" (R) added as the Hebrew has it.
decisions.reason: The temple refrain keeps one Japanese form across Chronicles and Ezra.

decisions.choice: vaya'anu "応答して歌った" (L), "互いに応え合って歌った" (B), "かわるがわる歌いました" (R).
decisions.reason: One group answering another (m1).

decisions.choice: "незмінна любов" (L, B), "вірна любов" (R) for God's chesed
decisions.reason: As the Old Testament terms note sets for the covenant love of God; Ukrainian "милість" would narrow it to pity.

source.text: וְרַבִּ֡ים מֵהַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּם֩ וְרָאשֵׁ֨י הָאָב֜וֹת הַזְּקֵנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר רָא֜וּ אֶת־הַבַּ֤יִת הָֽרִאשׁוֹן֙ בְּיָסְד֔וֹ זֶ֤ה הַבַּ֨יִת֙ בְּעֵ֣ינֵיהֶ֔ם בֹּכִ֖ים בְּק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל וְרַבִּ֛ים בִּתְרוּעָ֥ה בְשִׂמְחָ֖ה לְהָרִ֥ים קֽוֹל׃

records.literal_gloss: And many of the priests and the Levites and [the] heads of the fathers, the old [men] who had seen the house the first, at its founding, this the house, in their eyes, [were] weeping with a voice great; and many [were] with shout in joy to lift [the] voice.

en.L: And many of the priests and the Levites and the heads of the fathers' [houses], the old men who had seen the first house, when this house was founded before their eyes, were weeping with a loud voice; and many [were] shouting with joy, lifting up [their] voice.
en.B: But many of the priests and Levites and heads of families, the old men who had seen the first temple, wept aloud when they saw the foundation of this temple laid, while many others shouted for joy.
en.R: Many of the older priests, Levites and family leaders had seen the first temple. When they saw the foundation of this temple being laid, they cried loudly. But many others shouted with joy.

es.L: Y muchos de los sacerdotes y de los levitas y de los jefes de las [casas] paternas, los ancianos que habían visto la primera casa, cuando se echaron los cimientos de esta casa ante sus ojos, lloraban en alta voz; y muchos [daban] gritos de alegría, alzando [la] voz.
es.B: Pero muchos de los sacerdotes, los levitas y los jefes de familia, los ancianos que habían visto el primer templo, lloraban en voz alta al ver echar los cimientos de este templo, mientras muchos otros gritaban de alegría.
es.R: Muchos de los sacerdotes, levitas y jefes de familia de más edad habían visto el primer templo. Cuando vieron que se ponían los cimientos de este templo, lloraron en voz alta. Pero muchos otros gritaban de alegría.

fr.L: Et beaucoup des prêtres et des Lévites et des chefs des pères, les vieillards qui avaient vu la première maison, lorsque cette maison fut fondée sous leurs yeux, pleuraient à grande voix ; et beaucoup [poussaient] des cris de joie, élevant [la] voix.
fr.B: Mais beaucoup de prêtres, de Lévites et de chefs de famille, les vieillards qui avaient vu le premier temple, pleurèrent à grands cris quand ils virent poser les fondations de ce temple, tandis que beaucoup d’autres poussaient des cris de joie.
fr.R: Beaucoup des prêtres, des Lévites et des chefs de famille les plus âgés avaient vu le premier temple. Quand ils ont vu poser les fondations de ce temple, ils ont pleuré très fort. Mais beaucoup d’autres ont crié de joie.

sw.L: Na wengi wa makuhani na Walawi na wakuu wa [nyumba za] baba, wazee waliokuwa wameiona nyumba ya kwanza, nyumba hii ilipowekewa msingi mbele ya macho yao, walikuwa wakilia kwa sauti kuu; na wengi [walikuwa] wakipiga kelele kwa furaha, wakipaza sauti.
sw.B: Lakini wengi wa makuhani na Walawi na wakuu wa jamaa, wazee waliokuwa wameliona hekalu la kwanza, walilia kwa sauti kubwa walipoona msingi wa hekalu hili ukiwekwa, huku wengine wengi wakipiga kelele kwa furaha.
sw.R: Wengi wa makuhani, Walawi na viongozi wa jamaa waliokuwa wazee walikuwa wameliona hekalu la kwanza. Walipoona msingi wa hekalu hili ukiwekwa, walilia kwa sauti kubwa. Lakini wengine wengi walipiga kelele kwa furaha.

vi.L: Và nhiều người trong các thầy tế lễ, người Lê-vi và những người đứng đầu các gia tộc, là những người già đã thấy nhà thứ nhất, khi nhà này được đặt nền trước mắt họ, đã khóc lớn tiếng; và nhiều người [thì] reo hò vui mừng, cất cao tiếng.
vi.B: Nhưng nhiều thầy tế lễ, người Lê-vi và trưởng tộc, là những người già đã từng thấy đền thờ trước, khi thấy nền đền thờ này được đặt thì khóc lớn tiếng, trong khi nhiều người khác reo hò vui mừng.
vi.R: Nhiều thầy tế lễ, người Lê-vi và người đứng đầu các gia đình lớn tuổi đã từng thấy đền thờ thứ nhất. Khi thấy nền đền thờ này được đặt, họ khóc lớn. Nhưng nhiều người khác thì reo hò vui mừng.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장들과 레위 사람들과 조상들의 [집의] 우두머리들 가운데 많은 이들, 곧 첫 번째 집을 보았던 노인들은, 이 집의 기초가 그들의 눈앞에 놓일 때에 큰 소리로 울었다. 그리고 많은 이들은 기뻐서 함성을 지르며 소리를 높였다.
ko.B: 그러나 제사장들과 레위 사람들과 집안 우두머리들 가운데 첫 성전을 보았던 많은 노인들은, 이 성전의 기초가 놓이는 것을 보고 큰 소리로 울었다. 한편 다른 많은 사람들은 기뻐서 함성을 질렀다.
ko.R: 나이 든 제사장들과 레위 사람들과 집안 지도자들 가운데 많은 사람이 전에 있던 첫 성전을 보았었다. 그들은 이 성전의 기초가 놓이는 것을 보고 큰 소리로 울었다. 그러나 다른 많은 사람들은 기뻐서 소리쳤다.

pt.L: E muitos dos sacerdotes e dos levitas e dos chefes dos pais, os anciãos que tinham visto a primeira casa, quando esta casa foi fundada diante dos seus olhos, choravam em alta voz; e muitos [estavam] gritando de alegria, levantando [a sua] voz.
pt.B: Mas muitos dos sacerdotes, dos levitas e dos chefes das famílias, os mais velhos, que tinham visto o primeiro templo, choraram em alta voz quando viram lançados os alicerces deste templo, enquanto muitos outros gritavam de alegria.
pt.R: Muitos dos sacerdotes, levitas e chefes das famílias mais velhos tinham visto o primeiro templo. Quando viram os alicerces deste templo sendo lançados, choraram alto. Mas muitos outros gritaram de alegria.

am.L: ከካህናቱና ከሌዋውያኑም፣ ከአባቶች [ቤቶች] አለቆችም ብዙዎቹ፣ የመጀመሪያውን ቤት ያዩ ሽማግሌዎች፣ የዚህ ቤት መሠረት በዓይናቸው ፊት በተጣለ ጊዜ በታላቅ ድምፅ ያለቅሱ ነበር፤ ብዙዎቹም በደስታ እልልታ ድምፃቸውን ከፍ ያደርጉ ነበር።
am.B: ነገር ግን የመጀመሪያውን ቤተ መቅደስ ያዩ ብዙ ሽማግሌዎች ካህናት፣ ሌዋውያንና የቤተሰብ አለቆች የዚህ ቤተ መቅደስ መሠረት ሲጣል ባዩ ጊዜ ድምፃቸውን ከፍ አድርገው አለቀሱ፤ ሌሎች ብዙዎች ግን በደስታ እልል አሉ።
am.R: ከካህናቱ፣ ከሌዋውያኑና ከቤተሰብ መሪዎቹ መካከል ብዙ አረጋውያን የመጀመሪያውን ቤተ መቅደስ አይተው ነበር። የዚህ ቤተ መቅደስ መሠረት ሲጣል ባዩ ጊዜ ጮኸው አለቀሱ። ሌሎች ብዙዎች ግን በደስታ እልል አሉ።

hi.L: और याजकों और लेवियों और पितृकुलों के प्रधानों में से बहुत से बूढ़े, जिन्होंने पहला भवन देखा था, जब इस भवन की नींव उनकी आँखों के सामने डाली गई, ऊँचे स्वर से रो रहे थे; और बहुत से आनंद से जयजयकार करते हुए [अपना] स्वर ऊँचा कर रहे थे।
hi.B: पर याजकों, लेवियों और परिवारों के प्रधानों में से बहुत से बूढ़े लोग, जिन्होंने पहला मन्दिर देखा था, जब उन्होंने इस मन्दिर की नींव डाली जाते देखी, तब ऊँचे स्वर से रोए, जबकि बहुत से दूसरे लोग आनंद से जयजयकार करते रहे।
hi.R: याजकों, लेवियों और परिवारों के मुखियाओं में से बहुत से बूढ़ों ने पहला मन्दिर देखा था। जब उन्होंने इस मन्दिर की नींव डाली जाते देखी, तो वे ज़ोर-ज़ोर से रोने लगे। पर बहुत से दूसरे लोग आनंद से जयजयकार करते रहे।

ru.L: И многие из священников, и левитов, и глав отцовских [домов], старцы, которые видели первый дом, когда этот дом был основан у них на глазах, плакали громким голосом; а многие [восклицали] с радостным криком, возвышая голос.
ru.B: Но многие из священников, левитов и глав семей, старики, видевшие первый храм, громко плакали, когда у них на глазах закладывали основание этого храма, а многие другие радостно восклицали.
ru.R: Многие пожилые священники, левиты и главы семей видели первый храм. Когда они увидели, как закладывают основание этого храма, они громко плакали. А многие другие радостно кричали.

ja.L: そして祭司たちとレビ人たちと父祖の[家の]かしらたちのうちの多くの者、すなわち最初の家を見たことのある老人たちは、この家が彼らの目の前で基を据えられたとき、大声を上げて泣いた。しかし多くの者は喜びのあまり叫び、声を張り上げた。
ja.B: しかし、祭司、レビ人、一族のかしらたちの多くの者、すなわち最初の神殿を見たことのある老人たちは、この神殿の基礎が据えられるのを見て、大声で泣いた。一方、ほかの多くの者は喜びの声を上げた。
ja.R: 祭司やレビ人や家族の指導者たちの中には、前の神殿を見たことのあるお年寄りが大勢いました。この神殿の土台が据えられるのを見て、彼らは声を上げて泣きました。けれども、ほかの多くの人たちは喜んで叫びました。

uk.L: І багато зі священників, і левитів, і голів батьків, старі, які бачили перший дім, коли закладали цей дім на їхніх очах, плакали гучним голосом; а багато [було] з криком у радості, щоб піднести голос.
uk.B: Але багато священників, левитів і голів родин, старші люди, які бачили перший храм, голосно плакали, коли на їхніх очах закладали основу цього храму, тоді як багато інших радісно кричали.
uk.R: Багато старших священників, левитів і голів родів бачили ще перший храм. Коли вони побачили, як закладають основу цього храму, вони голосно плакали. А багато інших радісно кричали.

decisions.choice: the first house: Solomon's temple
decisions.reason: The first temple was burned by the Babylonians in 586 BC (2 Kings 25:9). This foundation was laid some fifty years later, so only the old could remember it.

decisions.choice: at its founding, this house, in their eyes: when this house was founded before their eyes
alternatives: who had seen the first house standing on its foundation
decisions.reason: The words are short and loosely joined. They are best read as one phrase: when the foundation of this house was laid in front of them. Another reading takes "at its founding" with the first house, "who had seen the first house on its foundation", and "this house in their eyes" as how the new one looked to them (compare Haggai 2:3). The sense, old men comparing the new with the old, is the same.

decisions.choice: weeping with a loud voice: the text does not say why
decisions.reason: Their weeping is set against the others' shouts of joy. Haggai 2:3 says that to those who had seen the former glory the new house looked like nothing; grief for what was lost is the natural reading, but the text itself does not give a reason.

decisions.choice: heads of the fathers: heads of families
decisions.reason: "The fathers" is short for "the fathers' houses", the extended families that made up the clans (2:59, 68).

decisions.choice: temple
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "temple" for "house" here, where the first and second buildings are compared, so that the reader is not left to work out which house is meant; Literal keeps "house".

decisions.choice: "templo" (B, R); "casa" (L)
decisions.reason: Where the first and second buildings are compared, Balanced and Readable say "templo", as the English does; Literal keeps "casa".

decisions.choice: "मन्दिर" (Balanced, Readable); "भवन" (Literal)
decisions.reason: Where the first and second buildings are compared, Balanced and Readable say मन्दिर for the house, as the English says "temple"; Literal keeps भवन.

decisions.choice: "перший дім", "цей дім" (L), "храм" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The English says "temple" at Balanced here, since the first house is Solomon's temple; Literal keeps the Hebrew word.

source.text: וְאֵ֣ין הָעָ֗ם מַכִּירִים֙ ק֚וֹל תְּרוּעַ֣ת הַשִּׂמְחָ֔ה לְק֖וֹל בְּכִ֣י הָעָ֑ם כִּ֣י הָעָ֗ם מְרִיעִים֙ תְּרוּעָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וְהַקּ֥וֹל נִשְׁמַ֖ע עַד־לְמֵרָחֽוֹק׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And not the people [were] distinguishing [the] sound of the shout of the joy from [the] sound of [the] weeping of the people, for the people [were] shouting a shout great, and the sound was heard to from afar.

en.L: And the people could not distinguish the sound of the shout of joy from the sound of the weeping of the people, for the people were shouting with a great shout, and the sound was heard far away.
en.B: No one could tell the sound of the shouts of joy from the sound of the people's weeping, because the people were shouting so loudly that the sound was heard far away.
en.R: No one could tell the shouts of joy apart from the sound of crying, because the people were so loud. The noise could be heard far away.

es.L: Y el pueblo no podía distinguir el sonido del grito de alegría del sonido del llanto del pueblo, porque el pueblo gritaba con gran júbilo, y el sonido se oía desde lejos.
es.B: Nadie podía distinguir el sonido de los gritos de alegría del sonido del llanto del pueblo, porque el pueblo gritaba tan fuerte que el sonido se oía desde lejos.
es.R: Nadie podía distinguir los gritos de alegría del sonido del llanto, porque la gente gritaba muy fuerte. El ruido se oía desde muy lejos.

fr.L: Et le peuple ne pouvait distinguer le son des cris de joie du son des pleurs du peuple, car le peuple poussait une grande clameur, et le son s’entendait jusqu’au loin.
fr.B: Personne ne pouvait distinguer le bruit des cris de joie du bruit des pleurs du peuple, car le peuple criait si fort qu’on l’entendait de loin.
fr.R: Personne ne pouvait faire la différence entre les cris de joie et les pleurs, parce que le peuple faisait beaucoup de bruit. On l’entendait de très loin.

sw.L: Na watu hawakuweza kupambanua sauti ya kelele za furaha na sauti ya kilio cha watu, kwa maana watu walikuwa wakipiga kelele kwa sauti kuu, na sauti ikasikika mbali.
sw.B: Hakuna aliyeweza kutofautisha sauti ya kelele za furaha na sauti ya kilio cha watu, kwa sababu watu walipiga kelele kwa nguvu sana hata sauti ikasikika mbali.
sw.R: Hakuna aliyeweza kutofautisha kelele za furaha na sauti ya kilio, kwa sababu watu walipiga kelele sana. Kelele hizo zilisikika mbali.

vi.L: Và dân chúng không thể phân biệt tiếng reo vui với tiếng khóc của dân chúng, vì dân chúng reo hò một tiếng reo lớn, và tiếng ấy vang đến tận xa.
vi.B: Không ai phân biệt được tiếng reo vui với tiếng khóc của dân chúng, vì dân chúng reo hò quá lớn đến nỗi tiếng vang xa.
vi.R: Không ai phân biệt được tiếng reo vui với tiếng khóc, vì dân chúng reo hò rất lớn. Tiếng ồn ấy vang đến tận nơi xa.

ko.L: 그리고 백성은 기쁨의 함성 소리와 백성의 울음소리를 구별할 수 없었다. 백성이 큰 함성을 질렀고, 그 소리가 멀리까지 들렸기 때문이다.
ko.B: 사람들은 기뻐하는 함성과 백성이 우는 소리를 구별할 수 없었다. 백성이 크게 소리를 질러 그 소리가 멀리까지 들렸기 때문이다.
ko.R: 기뻐서 지르는 소리와 우는 소리가 섞여서 아무도 그 둘을 구별할 수 없었다. 사람들이 너무 크게 소리를 질러서 그 소리가 멀리까지 들렸다.

pt.L: E o povo não conseguia distinguir o som do grito de alegria do som do choro do povo, porque o povo gritava com um grande grito, e o som se ouvia de longe.
pt.B: Ninguém conseguia distinguir o som dos gritos de alegria do som do choro do povo, porque o povo gritava tão alto que o som se ouvia de longe.
pt.R: Ninguém conseguia separar os gritos de alegria do som do choro, porque o povo fazia muito barulho. O barulho podia ser ouvido de longe.

am.L: ሕዝቡም የደስታውን እልልታ ድምፅ ከሕዝቡ ልቅሶ ድምፅ መለየት አልቻለም፤ ሕዝቡ በታላቅ እልልታ እልል ይል ነበርና፤ ድምፁም እስከ ሩቅ ድረስ ተሰማ።
am.B: ሕዝቡ እጅግ ይጮኽ ስለ ነበር ማንም የደስታውን እልልታ ድምፅ ከሕዝቡ የልቅሶ ድምፅ መለየት አልቻለም፤ ድምፁም እስከ ሩቅ ድረስ ይሰማ ነበር።
am.R: ሕዝቡ እጅግ ይጮኽ ስለ ነበር የደስታውን እልልታ ከልቅሶው ድምፅ ማንም መለየት አልቻለም። ጩኸቱም ከሩቅ ይሰማ ነበር።

hi.L: और लोग आनंद के जयजयकार के शब्द को लोगों के रोने के शब्द से अलग न पहचान सके, क्योंकि लोग बड़ा जयजयकार कर रहे थे, और वह शब्द दूर तक सुनाई देता था।
hi.B: कोई भी आनंद के जयजयकार के शब्द को लोगों के रोने के शब्द से अलग न पहचान सका, क्योंकि लोग इतने ऊँचे स्वर से जयजयकार कर रहे थे कि वह शब्द दूर तक सुनाई देता था।
hi.R: कोई भी आनंद की पुकार और रोने की आवाज़ में अंतर न कर सका, क्योंकि लोग बहुत ज़ोर से चिल्ला रहे थे। उनका शोर दूर तक सुनाई देता था।

ru.L: И не мог народ различить звука радостного восклицания от звука плача народа, потому что народ восклицал великим восклицанием, и звук был слышен далеко.
ru.B: Никто не мог отличить звуки радостных восклицаний от звука плача народа, потому что народ восклицал так громко, что шум был слышен далеко.
ru.R: Никто не мог отличить радостные крики от плача, потому что люди очень шумели. Этот шум был слышен далеко.

ja.L: そして民は、喜びの叫びの声と民の泣く声とを聞き分けることができなかった。民が大きな叫び声を上げていたので、その声は遠くまで聞こえた。
ja.B: だれも、喜びの叫び声と民の泣き声とを聞き分けることができなかった。民が大声で叫んでいたので、その声は遠くまで聞こえたのである。
ja.R: だれも、喜びの叫び声と泣き声を聞き分けることができませんでした。人々の声がとても大きかったからです。その声は、遠くまで聞こえました。

uk.L: І не розрізняв народ голосу радісного крику від голосу плачу народу, бо народ кричав великим криком, і голос був чутний аж далеко.
uk.B: Ніхто не міг відрізнити радісні вигуки від плачу народу, бо народ кричав так гучно, що голос було чути далеко.
uk.R: Ніхто не міг розрізнити, де радісні вигуки, а де плач, бо люди дуже голосно кричали. Шум було чути далеко.

decisions.choice: the people could not distinguish: no one could tell the sounds apart
decisions.reason: "The people" here are the hearers, the whole crowd: the joy and the weeping were mixed in one great noise.

decisions.choice: for the people were shouting: the reason the sounds could not be told apart
decisions.reason: The joining word gives the reason: the shout was so great that it covered the weeping, and it carried far beyond the temple site. The chapter closes on the sound of joy and grief together.

decisions.choice: No one could tell
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put "the people could not distinguish" as "no one could tell", since the same people did the shouting and the weeping.
